slides.texte_overlay:
5 life lessons from
men to men

1. LESSON

Between us men:
Always have one clean white shirt
ready, and know how to iron it.

2. LESSON

Call your mother early
on her birthday.
Be the first call, not the last.

3. LESSON

Never walk into an interview
without reading about the company.
They can tell.

4. LESSON

Carry a small notebook.
The man who writes things down
never forgets a promise.

5. LESSON

Learn about one new subject
every week. You'll never run out
of things to say.
slides.texte_sophia:
5. LESSON

Use a micro-learning app
like the Sophia app.
One new subject a week.
